objects.name: rev_config_globals_DELETE
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER rev_config_globals_DELETE AFTER DELETE ON config_globals BEGIN INSERT INTO config_revisions(student_id,key,revision) VALUES(0,OLD.key,1) ON CONFLICT(student_id,key) DO UPDATE SET revision=revision+1; END
